title: dbt v2.0 Launch and Data Engineering Career Challenges
body_md:
**TL;DR**

- dbt v2.0 reaches General Availability with a new Fusion engine.
- Recruiters and ATS tools are increasingly prioritizing exact-stack experience over transferable skills.
- Engineers are debating the utility of portfolios in an AI-driven job market.
- Practical discussions continue on API ingestion strategies and Databricks architecture.

The dbt ecosystem is a primary focus this week as dbt v2.0 reaches General Availability. This release introduces the dbt Fusion engine, marking a significant rewrite of the platform. Alongside the core update, dbt has released a new package, dbt_context_engineering, designed to help teams prepare data for AI agents. Discussions also touched on the distinction between the free distribution of dbt v2 and dbt OSS.

Beyond tooling, the data engineering community is grappling with a tightening job market. Professionals report that recruiters and AI-based ATS tools are increasingly using rigid checklist-style matching, making it difficult to demonstrate transferable skills. This has sparked a broader debate regarding the value of traditional portfolios, with many questioning if they remain meaningful when AI can easily generate project content.

Technical discourse remains grounded in daily operational challenges. Engineers are actively sharing strategies for robust API ingestion, particularly regarding error handling and data integrity in bronze-to-silver pipelines. Additionally, there is ongoing interest in Databricks architecture, with community members creating visual guides to explain the control plane, compute plane, and Unity Catalog to help peers navigate technical interviews.
